How Do I Get Pet Odors Out Of My Couch? 2021 Tips

January 15, 2021

Your fur buddy gives you love and comfort despite all the challenges you face daily. However, they also give you a headache when they pee or poop anywhere, especially on your couch. Besides that, they leave a distinct smell on your fabrics, which can be daunting to remove.

If you are seeking help to efficiently remove these pungent scents, then you’re in the right place since we’ll be featuring 9 simple tips for your pet odor eliminatorregimen. Continue reading to learn more about it.

Why Is It Wise To Avail Professional Upholstery Cleaning Service?

Indeed, you can do your carpet and upholstery washing yourself, yet if you don’t have the time to do it, then pass that to professionals. Moreover, below are the best benefits you enjoy from leaning on local cleaners.

  • Customized cleaning and disinfection
  • Pet stain and odor removal solutions
  • Savings with time and effort
  • Reasonable rates

  • Guaranteed satisfaction

#1 Daily Vacuuming

Perhaps, this is the most practical and standard practice you must do daily. When you regularly vacuum your couches, ottomans, and loveseats, then you are removing those pet danders and other dirt carried by your dogs and cats.

Alongside this, you can also invest in a small upholstery cleaning machine (like a wet/dry vacuum cleaner) that will help you suck up some pet urine from your fabrics. Then you can buy some commercial pet pee stain removerin any store.

#2 Out With The Soiled Blankets and Pillows From Your Couch

If your fur buddy is roaming around and you left some blankets and pillows on your couch, then expect them to lie on it. Consequently, you need to remove these items from your couch to avoid letting any pet urine, hairs, and debris linger and promote bacterial growth.

When the stains and foul odor isn’t that worse yet, then you can wash it on your own. You can wash it like once or twice a month, yet it depends on how often it is soiled.

However, if the problem is worse, then you can avail of a professional pet stain and odor removersservice near you.

#3 Frequently Change Your Couch Covers and Wash It

Investing in couch covers is also a wise decision so that there’s first-layer protection from your couch. Similar to your blankets and pillows, you can wash your couch covers once a month or every three weeks.

Before washing, be sure to read the label to avoid discoloration or fabric damages. Likewise, you can invest in a pet stain eraserservice from your local cleaning company. If you haven’t found an upholstery cleaning service, then call us out today.

#4 Sprinkle with Baking Soda Then Vacuum It

If you think your vacuuming doesn’t work, then try sprinkling some baking soda over your couch where your pet usually sits. Baking soda is a natural odor deodorizer that doesn’t harm fabrics.

Let the baking soda sit overnight on your couch and then vacuum it in the morning. Unfortunately, if this still doesn’t work, then avail of our affordable pet odor removal costtoday.

#5 Use Fabric Freshener

Meanwhile, you can also boost the fresh scent of your couch and upholsteries when you spray it with a fabric freshener. You can shop online or in your nearest grocery store for a commercial fabric freshener to use for this trick.

Nevertheless, make sure to clean your couch before spraying it, otherwise, the strong pungent odor of pet accidents will dominate.

#6 Shop For An Enzyme Deodorizer

Besides fabric freshener, you can shop for any commercial enzyme deodorizer in big box stores and home improvement shops. These products are friendly to fabrics, pets, and children, so you can try using them as well.

Nevertheless, make sure to read its product label to check on the best practices and precautions.

#7 Rent Industrial Carpet Cleaning Machine

If you have the skills and experience of professionally cleaning your couches and furniture, then you can just rent an upholstery cleaning machine. With that, you can save on labor costs for hiring a local cleaning company.

Before cleaning your couches, always read its wash instructions, so you’ll know what are the recommended cleaning solutions and practices.

Nonetheless, if you have not enough time to do the cleaning on your own, then better call us to book an appointment or ask for a free quote.

#8 Create Your Own Homemade Pet Odor Removal Solution

You can search online for simple DIY homemade solutions for removing pet odors on upholsteries. Oftentimes, the usual ingredients include baking soda, vodka, white vinegar, dishwashing solution, and water.

Some food ingredients like apple cider and lemon oils also work as a natural deodorizing agent for those pungent smells. However, if you are unsure of making it, then either buy a commercial cleaning product or hire a local upholstery cleaning service.

#9 Hire A Professional Upholstery Cleaning Service

All those DIY tips we mentioned above can work well in mitigating or completely eliminating pungent odor from your fur buddy’s urine, saliva, and feces. When you hire a professional upholstery cleaning service near you, they have extensive experience and cleaning machines to handle the job.
